reviews.review_description: The goalkeeper mode is outstanding. Anyone who wants to become a real world goalkeeper can train on this virtual soccer simulator. It really tests the reflexes. 100% recommended.

I'm not really a football fan, so I honestly didn't expect this to be my favorite. 
The colorful presentation and stadium atmosphere immediately make a good impression, and the tutorial makes everything easy to understand. I especially enjoyed playing as the goalkeeper and actually managed to pull off some satisfying saves! Shooting takes more practice. The early access game already has a really enjoyable foundation and I had much more fun with it than I expected. A very promising VR football experience!
